name: seal
description: Evidence-backed Acceptance for Native Coding Agent work.

interface.longDescription: Make Seal available to Native Coding Agents for explicit or repository-opted-in use. Seal records one Task and exact Evidence Run, reports its mechanical state, and applies Basic completion without taking over planning, implementation, or workflow control.
defaultPrompt: @Seal 이 저장소의 다음 구현 작업을 Task로 기록하고 검증해줘
이 구현 작업에 Seal이 적합한지 판단하고 필요하면 Acceptance Evidence를 남겨줘
@Seal 정확한 Task와 Run의 저장 상태 및 mechanical 결과를 확인해줘
